acceptanceGate.command: node --test --test-concurrency=3 test/voice/caller-identity-denial.test.ts test/voice/appointment-change-intent.test.ts test/voice/approved-booking-search.test.ts test/voice/booking-request-boundaries.test.ts test/voice/clinic-faqs.test.ts test/voice/urgent-conversation-routing.test.ts test/voice/cliniko-staff-request.test.ts test/voice/staff-review-expectations.test.ts test/voice/conversation-baseline.test.ts test/contract/scenario-manifest.test.ts

assertions: Actual minimum eligible start across two approved practitioners
Same exact minimum in native agent selection
No patient/appointment read or private appointment speech at admission, nor provider work/mail/write at identity denial; synthetic patient-name/model/speech/PostgreSQL canaries clear.
Literal nine-o’clock target is played, discarded on ten-o’clock disagreement, reread unchanged and separately confirmed before one exact non-recurring cancellation PATCH.
Actual scoped offer and POST business/practitioner/type/patient/start match Demo North and the approved selected practitioner.
Initial human requests do not invent saved/read/received/callback status; unavailable contact cannot start a booking or write.
Inspected proxy, minor-intake, medical-clearance and urgent-response paths use exact bounded clinic contact/approved public replies and cannot create unauthorized patient or staff authority.

baselineReused.reason: Every evaluator input is byte-for-byte unchanged; added tests are independently hashed rather than silently treated as part of that baseline.

privacy: Only synthetic patient names are injected in test responses; no production provider logging/storage, new patient persistence or real clinic/email/carrier activation is added.
remainingScope: Appointment read/outcome, late-arrival and remaining original search/information clauses remain open; all original required/forbidden clauses are preserved.
